scope: Bounded malformed RASTERVARIABLES body recovery and strict/explicit-partial CLI refusal for dependency-root sources.

source.kind: scratch-only DWGs authored at test runtime by the in-tree DWG writer; each valid typed seed is converted to a raw mutated frame and injected with matching custom-class registration
source.object: RASTERVARIABLES class version 0, image-frame 1, image-quality 1, and units 1, registered under the generated ACAD_IMAGE_VARS named-object dictionary entry. The typed source uses the direct NOD parent and reciprocal reactor profile.
source.bodyMutation: A one-bit mutation after the fully validated common prologue is selected inside the declared object body and makes DRW_RasterVariables::parseDwg fail. The root dictionary entry remains byte-valid and points at the failed frame.
source.excludedVersion: AC1024: the bounded one-bit body-span search found no parser-failing mutation; no recovery claim is made for this revision.

implementation.controls: For each eligible revision, the reader reports one object parse failure and one failed frame, retains the following LINE, and balances source = published + failed. Strict conversion refuses atomically because the read is incomplete. Explicit-partial conversion also refuses atomically because the retained ACAD_IMAGE_VARS root dictionary entry targets the failed RASTERVARIABLES frame. AC1027 is refused at the existing source-reference qualification gate in both modes. The input bytes remain unchanged.

results.outputQualification: No output/readback profile is qualified. Strict conversion refuses on incomplete DWG disposition; explicit-partial conversion refuses when extension-object graph validation detects the ACAD_IMAGE_VARS NOD target is missing or ambiguous. AC1027 remains behind its source-reference gate.

limitations: Generated reader-recovery and fail-closed CLI evidence only; it establishes no successful output/readback, RASTERVARIABLES field semantics, producer prevalence, or interoperability.
